name: Whittwood Town Center
summary: Whittwood Town Center is a large community shopping plaza in Whittier featuring big-box retailers, a grocery anchor, and diverse dining options including fast-food and restaurants. This convenient open-air center serves as a one-stop destination for everyday shopping needs and family-friendly services.
demographics: Whittwood Town Center serves a diverse, middle-class community in Whittier, California, with a strong Hispanic demographic presence alongside established families and working professionals. The trade area attracts shoppers primarily in the 25-54 age range with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, including young families and dual-income households seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and value-oriented retail. Visitors typically engage in routine shopping trips combining grocery runs with quick-service dining and big-box retail purchases, reflecting the practical, family-focused nature of the surrounding residential neighborhoods.
description: Whittwood Town Center stands as a prominent community shopping destination in Whittier, California, serving the local population with a comprehensive mix of big-box retailers, dining options, and essential services. Located at 15466 Whittier Boulevard, this open-air shopping plaza has evolved into a convenient one-stop destination for families and residents throughout the greater Whittier area. The center features an anchoring grocery store alongside major national retailers, providing shoppers with everything from household essentials to fashion and home goods under one roof. Fast-food chains and sit-down restaurants offer diverse dining choices for shoppers looking to refuel during their visit or enjoy a casual meal with family. With ample parking, accessible layout, and a tenant mix focused on everyday needs and value, Whittwood Town Center has established itself as a reliable community gathering place that combines convenience with variety for the neighborhoods it serves.
